title: 부엌, 밖, 앞, 있다: 받침은 어떻게 읽어요?
objective: By the end, you can read and pronounce words that end in ㅋ, ㄲ, ㅍ and ㅆ, such as 부엌, 밖, 앞 and 있다.
summary: At the end of a syllable, ㅋ and ㄲ sound like [ㄱ], ㅍ sounds like [ㅂ], and ㅆ sounds like [ㄷ].

task.title: Read and sound out
task.line: Say each word aloud first. Then write or choose the sound you hear.

words.exampleMeaning: the café in front of the school

words.meaning: to exist; to be (somewhere); to have

letters.as: Like k in 'book', but with no puff of air: 부엌 [부억], 밖 [박]
Like p in 'stop'. Keep your lips closed: 앞 [압], 옆 [엽], 높다 [놉따]
Like t in 'hot dog'. Keep your tongue up. A ㄷ after it sounds strong: 있다 [읻따]
Before a vowel, you hear the real letter: 밖에 [바께], 있어요 [이써요]

exercises: Which sound does the final consonant make: [ㄱ], [ㅂ], or [ㄷ]? ① 숲 ② 닦다 ③ 했다
Do the two words sound the same? Write Same or Different. ① 박 — 밖 ② 입 — 잎 ③ 앞 — 악
Choose the right pronunciation. ① 부엌에 [부어게 / 부어케] ② 갔어요 [갇어요 / 가써요] ③ 옆으로 [여브로 / 여프로]
Find the word whose batchim (final consonant) sound is different from the other two. ① 부엌 · 앞 · 책 ② 옆 · 밥 · 있다 ③ 했다 · 밖 · 곧
answers: ① Same ([박]) ② Same ([입]) ③ Different ([압] / [악])
① 앞 ([ㅂ]; 부엌 and 책 end in [ㄱ]) ② 있다 ([ㄷ]; 옆 and 밥 end in [ㅂ]) ③ 밖 ([ㄱ]; 했다 and 곧 end in [ㄷ])
